node.scope: Real pinned Q8 database, exact remote module and original lens function, five pairs both modes all levels, symmetry/monotonicity/integrity, individual lenses and category checks.

browser.scope: Chromium local HTTP; no rendered browser gate. Enabled A4 union not tested in this turn.

limitations: Common mode returns real simple path witnesses derived from deterministic BFS trees, not all simple paths. Existing Mundi lens semantics preserved; other layers independent when any lens is active.
Extended mode stops expansion through intermediate categories other than persons, works, cultural networks and institutions. No automatic graph truncation; large levels may be heavy.
No edits to database or certified Q7b viewer.
